# RayonWeb Solutions
> Software development company providing custom web, mobile, AI, DevOps, QA, and UI/UX solutions for startups, SMEs, and enterprises globally.

Actively hiring 2024, 2025 & 2026 Batch freshers (B.Tech, B.E., BCA, MCA, B.Sc CS/IT) with React.js, Next.js 14/15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and REST APIs. Location: Mohali / Hybrid / Remote. ## Core Services
- [Web Development](https://rayonweb.com/services/web-development): Custom websites, ecommerce storefronts, and CMS integration engineered for speed and SEO.
- [App Development](https://rayonweb.com/services/app-development): Native and cross-platform mobile experiences with robust architectures and offline support.
- [AI & Machine Learning](https://rayonweb.com/services/ai-ml): LLM development, computer vision, conversational AI, and predictive analytics for business automation.
- [DevOps & Cloud](https://rayonweb.com/services/devops-cloud): Continuous Integration and Delivery (CI/CD), AWS setup, and Docker/Kubernetes container orchestration.
- [UI/UX Design](https://rayonweb.com/services/ui-ux-design): Research-driven user interface design, interactive prototyping, and scalable design systems.
- [LMS & Integrations](https://rayonweb.com/services/lms-integration): Custom learning management systems, payment gateways, and CRM/API workflow integrations.
- [QA & Automation](https://rayonweb.com/services/qa-automation): QA testing services, manual exploratory testing, and automated CI test suites.

## Service Sub-Specialties
- [Custom Website Design](https://rayonweb.com/services/web-development/custom-website-design): Responsive, brand-led website designs optimized for lead generation.
- [Ecommerce Solutions](https://rayonweb.com/services/web-development/ecommerce-solutions): Secure checkout flows, catalog structures, and multi-vendor shopping platforms.
- [CMS Integration](https://rayonweb.com/services/web-development/cms-integration): Content workflows with headless or monolithic CMS setups like WordPress, Strapi, or Sanity.
- [Mobile Apps](https://rayonweb.com/services/app-development/mobile-apps): Native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) applications with high performance.
- [Cross-Platform Apps](https://rayonweb.com/services/app-development/cross-platform-apps): Hybrid apps built with React Native and Flutter for unified codebase efficiency.
- [Progressive Web Apps](https://rayonweb.com/services/app-development/progressive-web-apps): PWAs combining web accessibility with app-like caching and installability.
- [LLM Development](https://rayonweb.com/services/ai-ml/llm-development): LLM-powered applications, RAG pipelines, prompt orchestration, and custom agent systems.
- [AI Integration](https://rayonweb.com/services/ai-ml/ai-integration): Connecting commercial APIs (OpenAI, Gemini) with existing business software.
- [Conversational AI](https://rayonweb.com/services/ai-ml/conversational-ai): Multi-turn chatbots and voice assistants designed for customer support.
- [Computer Vision](https://rayonweb.com/services/ai-ml/computer-vision): Object detection, image segmentation, optical character recognition (OCR), and visual inspection.
- [Custom Model Training](https://rayonweb.com/services/ai-ml/custom-model-training): Training and fine-tuning machine learning models using specialized datasets.
- [Hugging Face Model Integration](https://rayonweb.com/services/ai-ml/hugging-face-models): Utilizing pre-trained transformer models for custom NLP and vision workflows.
- [Predictive Analytics](https://rayonweb.com/services/ai-ml/predictive-analytics): Turning historical metrics into actionable business forecasts.
- [MLOps & Model Monitoring](https://rayonweb.com/services/ai-ml/mlops-model-monitoring): Operations, tracking, versioning, and drift monitoring of models in production.
- [CI/CD Pipelines](https://rayonweb.com/services/devops-cloud/ci-cd-pipelines): Automated test and release cycles using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
- [Cloud Setup](https://rayonweb.com/services/devops-cloud/cloud-setup): Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) design, serverless setups, database clustering, and security on AWS/GCP.
- [Docker & Kubernetes](https://rayonweb.com/services/devops-cloud/docker-kubernetes): Multi-tier application containerization and cluster orchestration.
- [Web & Mobile Design](https://rayonweb.com/services/ui-ux-design/web-mobile-design): Intuitive user interfaces and interaction maps for desktop and mobile devices.
- [Wireframes & Prototyping](https://rayonweb.com/services/ui-ux-design/wireframes-prototyping): Interactive visual prototypes to validate flows before writing code.
- [Design Systems](https://rayonweb.com/services/ui-ux-design/design-systems): Consistent UI component sets and design tokens for accelerated development.
- [Custom LMS Development](https://rayonweb.com/services/lms-integration/custom-lms): Core LMS development for course creation, enrollment, tracking, and certification.
- [Payment Integration](https://rayonweb.com/services/lms-integration/payment-integration): Integration of Stripe, PayPal, Razorpay, and subscription billing modules.
- [CRM & API Integration](https://rayonweb.com/services/lms-integration/crm-api-integration): Connecting CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot) to synchronise data.
- [Manual Testing](https://rayonweb.com/services/qa-automation/manual-testing): Human exploratory, functional, usability, and regression testing workflows.
- [Automated CI Tests](https://rayonweb.com/services/qa-automation/automated-ci-tests): Building Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium suites for automated checks.
- [Performance Audits](https://rayonweb.com/services/qa-automation/performance-audits): Speed auditing, Core Web Vitals profiling, and database query optimization.

- [Allen & Unwin](https://rayonweb.com/projects/allen-and-unwin): Custom publisher website supporting book discovery, author submission resources, and media portals.

- [Murdoch Books](https://rayonweb.com/projects/murdoch-books): Visual lifestyle publisher website with extensive cookery and gardening catalog paths.
- [Australian Copyright Council](https://rayonweb.com/projects/australian-copyright-council): Educational legal service portal built to improve public copyright access.
- [Affirm Press](https://rayonweb.com/projects/affirm-press): Melbourne-based publisher portal focusing on Australian stories and author engagement.
- [Banking Quest](https://rayonweb.com/projects/banking-quest): Accredited online education platform for 500,000+ banking professionals in India.
- [DiMO Book Publishing Software](https://rayonweb.com/projects/dimo-book-publishing-software): Workflow and dashboard dashboard software for publisher operational control.
- [PlayQuizNow](https://rayonweb.com/projects/playquiznow): Interactive quiz generation and high-scale social engagement portal.
- [Toolsy](https://rayonweb.com/projects/toolsy): Proprietary utility suite featuring 40+ free SEO, AI, and document processing tools.
